description: Create a resource from a generated manifest spec, sent over stdin.

image.description: Container image to use in the generated manifest; defaults to the resource name when omitted.

name.description: Name for the resource to create.

namespace.description: Namespace to create the resource in; when omitted, no namespace is set in the generated manifest.

resource_type.description: Kubernetes resource type to create, such as deployment or pod.

name: kubectl_create
